notes.title: Quality of Life Changes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39870933/a45f761a8137b0fb73a3ae65659b148865ba822a.png[/img]

Hi Friends,

We have made some quality of life changes such revamping the UI and cleaning up the menu. We have also updated the base map. Now you can build in a vaporwave world like all things should. Moreover, with this recent update we are also introducing build battle mode where friends can build, design and then rate each other's designs! We are working on uploading and downloading with Mod.io currently and bring in a seasons game mode where every player will be competing in a season to see who ranks the highest. 


Qube On,
James Chen

notes.title: We Have Multiplayer Now!
notes.notes:
Dear Friends,

After 2 weeks of struggling, we are pleased to announce that we now support Multiplayer (Co-op). You can now design and build with friends or mess up your friend's works! If you would like to become a play tester, please join our discord: https://discord.gg/WdyuffsfJW and let us know!

Thanks,
James Chen
